name: geolibre-rust
description: whitebox_next_gen geospatial tools (plus new GeoLibre tools) compiled to WebAssembly (WASI) for in-browser use in GeoLibre

issues.title: topo_to_raster terraces dense contours: every cell a contour crosses is fixed at the contour's height

latest_release.name: v1.8.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump wbspatialstats from `6d88aaa` to `dab6e43` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/612
* build(deps): bump wbtopology from `6d88aaa` to `dab6e43` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/613
* build(deps): bump wbvector from `6d88aaa` to `dab6e43` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/614
* build(deps): bump wblidar from `6d88aaa` to `dab6e43` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/615
* build(deps): bump the actions-minor-patch group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/620
* build(deps): bump the cargo-minor-patch group across 1 directory with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/621
* ci: install a pinned binaryen release instead of the apt package by @giswqs in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/625
* fix(manifests): type values the inference read as datasets from the schema table by @elpidioassinaturas in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/623
* fix(manifests): mark the inputs backfilled tools need as required by @elpidioassinaturas in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/624
* fix(cli): pass JSON lists and objects given on the command line by @giswqs in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/626
* fix(deps): bump whitebox-wasm for Swiss (EPSG:2056) and Brazil Albers (EPSG:10857) projections by @giswqs in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/627
* fix(deps): bump whitebox-wasm for the frangi_filter fix by @giswqs in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/628
* chore(release): bump version to 1.8.2 by @giswqs in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/629

## New Contributors
* @elpidioassinaturas made their first contribution in https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/pull/623

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/opengeos/geolibre-rust/compare/v1.8.1...v1.8.2
